Princess Eugenie: 10 Things You Need to Know About the Royal in 2025

6 Aug, 2026
|

Princess Eugenie: A Modern Royal with a Distinctive Voice

Princess Eugenie of York has carved out her own unique space within the British royal family, distinguishing herself through both her charitable advocacy and her unapologetically modern approach to public life. As the second daughter of Prince Andrew and the late Sarah, Duchess of York, she stands as a prominent figure in contemporary royal coverage—often making headlines not just for her lineage, but for the personal choices that set her apart.

Early Life and Education

Born on 23 March 1990 at St Mary’s Hospital in London, Princess Eugenie grew up alongside her elder sister, Princess Beatrice, in a family that has always been under intense media scrutiny. Her upbringing was marked by the challenges that accompany life in the public eye, yet she pursued her passions with determination and grace.

Eugenie attended Coworth Park School and later St George’s School in Windsor before going on to study English Literature and History at Newcastle University. She graduated with a 2:2 degree in 2012 and furthered her education at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA), where she trained in acting and screen studies. This artistic pursuit revealed a creative side that would later influence her public engagements and personal brand.

A Public Coming-of-Age

Princess Eugenie’s entry into full royal duties was briefly paused when she was diagnosed with scoliosis as a teenager. She underwent corrective surgery at the age of eighteen, and the resulting scar on her back became a topic of public discussion. Rather than hiding it, Eugenie chose to embrace it—a decision that resonated deeply with fans and positioned her as a vocal advocate for body positivity and transparency about health matters.

This stance became even more visible when she posed for a striking photograph for The Evening Standard in 2019, deliberately showcasing her scar. The image generated widespread praise and sparked meaningful conversations about self-acceptance. It was a defining moment in her public persona and reinforced her reputation as a royal unafraid to challenge convention.

Charity Work and Advocacy

Throughout her royal career, Princess Eugenie has championed several causes that hold personal significance. She has served as a patron of the Lantman Foundation, which supports survivors of human trafficking and exploitation, drawing on her interest in global justice and humanitarian issues. She has also worked with the Redress Trust, focusing on legal support for victims of historical abuse.

Her dedication to these causes reflects a broader commitment to using her platform for meaningful social impact. Eugenie has spoken openly about the importance of giving voice to those who have been silenced, and her advocacy work has earned her respect both within and beyond royal circles.

Marriage and Family Life

In July 2018, Princess Eugenie married Jack Brooksbank at St George’s Chapel, Windsor Castle. The wedding, attended by members of the royal family and celebrated across the globe, marked one of the most anticipated royal events of the decade. The couple met through a mutual friend, and their relationship was noted for its warmth and informality—a refreshing contrast to some of the more formal royal unions of recent years.

Eugenie and Jack have two children: August Brooksbank, born in 2021, and Ernest Brooksbank, born in 2023. As a mother, Eugenie has continued to balance family life with her royal responsibilities, often sharing glimpses of her parenting journey on social media in a way that feels genuine and relatable.

Style and Public Presence

Princess Eugenie is widely recognized for her fashion-forward approach, often wearing bold colors and statement pieces that reflect her artistic background. Her style has been featured in numerous fashion publications, and she has collaborated with brands that align with her values. Whether walking a red carpet or attending a daytime engagement, her wardrobe choices consistently draw attention—and not all of it is purely sartorial.

Her confidence and individuality have made her a favorite among younger audiences who see in her a modern royal who is both accomplished and authentically herself. This connection with a new generation of followers speaks to her ability to evolve the role of a senior royal without losing sight of tradition.

Looking Ahead

As Princess Eugenie continues to develop her role within the royal family, her trajectory points toward a future defined by purposeful advocacy, creative expression, and a commitment to representing the complexities of modern womanhood. With each public appearance and charitable initiative, she reinforces the idea that being a royal in the twenty-first century does not require conformity—it requires conviction.

Whether through her charity work, her family life, or her distinctive public presence, Princess Eugenie remains a figure of enduring interest. For anyone following the evolving story of the British monarchy, her journey offers a compelling glimpse into what the future of royal service might look like.
